The '''Iope system''' was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Mining Guild cutter|starship]] ''[[Iopene Princess]]''.<ref name="BadFeeling">{{StoryCite|story=A Bad Feeling: The Tale of EV-9D9|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Iope [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
